current_subject.object: Project economic research method behavior for both fresh-context and long-context AI; project-only method, AGENTS and behavioral/NR tests

why_this_work_can_change_the_decision: Existing canonical method covers anti-PARK and provenance, but lacks an explicit, testable common economic research process and distinct fresh/long-context failure-mode handling. Prevent false economic PASS and misplaced abandonment.
minimal_decisive_test: Run project-owned deterministic dual-profile challenge cases and existing canonical method NR suite on exact project contract; independent actual fresh/long-context model witness remains separate and not implied by static tests.
counterexample: A PR-only workflow-run lookup falsely claims no push run; two downloads of the same five sessions are called independent out-of-sample evidence; a negative same-day oracle wrongly falsifies all ETF value-relative mechanisms; a broker-only BLOCK is generalized to scientific FAIL.
